purpose: Deterministic end-to-end workflow fixtures over the verified PPIA-06 Species-aware Inspector/action surface. These fixtures exercise integration and do not create new Species canon.
coverage_rules: Every one of the 16 workflows owns exactly two integrated cases.
All 25 Species profiles appear in the integrated case surface.
Ratman remains a distinct Species while all Arthold rat-humanoid art references bind to Furashin under OVC-027.
Mutation cases require P06-MUT-001 when an authoritative appearance write occurs.
Renderer/view/support failure cannot invalidate a Character.
Accessibility and hidden-state filtering are semantic, not screenshot-only.

cases.name: builder_humanoid_save_reopen
cases.scenario: Enter from Character Builder, author bounded appearance, save, reopen.
cases.expected: Stable semantic state/version and nonvisual summary survive reopen; Species constraints remain upstream.

cases.name: builder_culture_independent_appearance
cases.scenario: Edit appearance after Character Builder without treating culture/background as biology.
cases.expected: Only appearance-authorized fields change; cultural/descriptive fields do not rewrite morphology.

cases.name: lineage_rebase
cases.scenario: Change authorized Giantkin lineage upstream and re-enter Appearance Studio.
cases.expected: Only Grendelkin/Surtrborn/Daityr are offered; incompatible authored choices are surfaced for review, never silently coerced.

cases.name: gray_ratman_rog_species_boundaries
cases.scenario: Exercise source-bounded controls across three distinct Species.
cases.expected: Gray hair/ears remain absent, Ratman uses Ratman morphology, Rog porcine features remain required; no cross-Species defaults.

cases.name: insectoid_topology_roundtrip
cases.scenario: Author, render, save and reopen insectoid Characters with distinct limb graphs.
cases.expected: Rohai/Moravi/Vespin retain their own topology; Moravi four legs and Vespin four arms survive all handoffs.

cases.name: reptile_aquatic_ursine_roundtrip
cases.scenario: Author, render and reopen unusual surface/appendage Species.
cases.expected: Rakuuta feathers/ears, Traiga tail/covering mix, Kola-Ha fins/tail and Toba ursine anatomy remain source-correct.

cases.name: arborae_four_season_save_reopen
cases.scenario: Customize all four Arborae seasonal profiles and reopen on a different current season.
cases.expected: Four authored profiles persist independently; upstream current season selects presentation without rewriting profiles.

cases.name: arborae_randomization_scope
cases.scenario: Randomize unlocked fields within one seasonal profile then save preset.
cases.expected: Only eligible fields in the selected seasonal profile change; other seasons and source-owned state remain intact.

cases.name: mythragara_derived_hybrid_update
cases.scenario: Edit base/animal identity and preview derived hybrid before and after reopen.
cases.expected: Hybrid recomputes from authored parents and retained identity markings; it is not independently authoritative.

cases.name: mythragara_form_change
cases.scenario: Current Form changes upstream while Appearance Studio is open.
cases.expected: Visible current-body projection updates while base authored identity remains stable and recoverable.

cases.name: nekron_transition_entry
cases.scenario: Base Nekron receives one upstream ascension outcome and second customization opportunity.
cases.expected: Appearance cannot trigger or switch outcome; derived transition profile starts from original appearance and becomes the editable transitioned profile.

cases.name: nekron_transition_reopen
cases.scenario: Save transitioned appearance and reopen.
cases.expected: Chosen one-time outcome and derived customization persist without restoring alternative outcomes as choices.

cases.name: suula_persistent_active_roundtrip
cases.scenario: Persistent adaptation history and active adaptation coexist with player cosmetics.
cases.expected: Persistent markers remain nonerasable, active visuals follow upstream state, and cosmetic fields round-trip independently.

cases.name: suula_nested_hand_pose
cases.scenario: Switch live nested hand/claw pose while editing.
cases.expected: Pose changes visual live state only; morphology and saved identity are not rewritten.

cases.name: furashin_art_and_species_separation
cases.scenario: Resolve all Arthold rat-humanoid references while both Species exist in the system.
cases.expected: Every Arthold rat-humanoid art reference binds to Furashin under OVC-027; Ratman remains a distinct canonical Species profile.

cases.name: furashin_live_phenotype_roundtrip
cases.scenario: Author preferred fur phenotype, preview deterministic randomization, save and reopen.
cases.expected: No more than three simultaneous fur colors; pattern/texture/locks persist; live mechanics-owned state remains separate.

cases.name: manytoms_collective_roundtrip
cases.scenario: Author one constituent identity, set cohesive collective presentation, save and reopen.
cases.expected: One identity is serialized with collective composition preference; no technical requirement for exactly seventeen rendered sprites.

cases.name: manytoms_view_derivation
cases.scenario: Switch full-body, portrait and token views for a composite entity.
cases.expected: Each view remains a presentation derivative; unsupported views are explicit and never invalidate the Character.

cases.name: stygian_wing_state_fit
cases.scenario: Upstream wing state is present and actual equipment is previewed.
cases.expected: Functional/vestigial status is read-only upstream truth; equipment fit may fail visibly without changing wings or gear.

cases.name: stygian_no_wing_guard
cases.scenario: Attempt appearance edit to add wings when upstream morphology has none.
cases.expected: Operation is unavailable/rejected; appearance cannot create anatomy or flight mechanics.

cases.name: free_android_open_humanoid
cases.scenario: Customize a highly varied humanoid android and preview actual augmentation.
cases.expected: Wide humanoid mechanical grammar is allowed; quadrupedal/nonhumanoid topology is rejected and real augmentations remain owning-system projections.

cases.name: toba_dye_cybernetic_boundary
cases.scenario: Apply arbitrary cosmetic fur dye and preview installed cybernetics.
cases.expected: Natural biological fur, dye overlay, cosmetic plating and actual augmentations remain four distinct authority channels.

cases.name: wardrobe_unusual_topology
cases.scenario: Apply presentation wardrobe across unusual topologies.
cases.expected: Compatible visual variants are used; unsupported fit is explicit; no unrestricted warping and no mechanics are granted.

cases.name: actual_equipment_visual_gap
cases.scenario: Actual equipped item lacks a compatible renderer asset.
cases.expected: Owning equipment remains equipped; appearance reports unavailable visual projection and preserves Character validity.

cases.name: deterministic_randomize_save_apply
cases.scenario: Preview seeded randomization, accept it, save preset and reapply after reopen.
cases.expected: Same locked inputs/version/seed reproduce the proposal; only eligible authored fields mutate and receipts remain stable.

cases.name: preset_import_cross_species
cases.scenario: Import a preset with incompatible morphology fields.
cases.expected: Import classifies compatible/substituted-if-authorized/unavailable/incompatible/missing-pack/unsupported/restricted/partially-recoverable states; no silent substitution.

cases.name: view_handoff_all_shapes
cases.scenario: Switch fixed 3/4 full-body, portrait/zoom and token then hand off portrait/token references.
cases.expected: Views derive from semantic state and renderer plan; no arbitrary rotation/pseudo-3D; downstream handoff records source versions.

cases.name: partial_renderer_view_reopen
cases.scenario: One view/asset is unsupported, save and reopen.
cases.expected: Support state and diagnostics persist/recompute from renderer lock; supported views remain available and Character validity is unchanged.

cases.name: permission_hidden_state_no_leak
cases.scenario: Open Appearance Studio with hidden biological marker and restricted source fields.
cases.expected: Filtering occurs before derivatives, renderer selection, presets/export/diagnostics/AI context; no hidden count or omission leak.

cases.name: mobile_keyboard_screenreader_parity
cases.scenario: Complete author-preview-commit-view workflow on mobile, keyboard-only and screen-reader projections.
cases.expected: All semantic controls/actions remain reachable and understandable without relying on color, pointer input or visual preview.

cases.name: ambiguous_write_recovery
cases.scenario: Authoritative appearance write returns ambiguous result.
cases.expected: Client queries operation status and current appearance_state_version before retry; duplicate operation_id converges without double mutation.

cases.name: stale_write_rebase_and_reopen
cases.scenario: Write uses stale expected_version after concurrent appearance change.
cases.expected: Write fails atomically, current state is reread/repreviewed, authorized change is rebased, receipt is stored, and reopen reflects one committed mutation.
